camera.missing: Audio only — no camera on this device
camera.busy: Audio only — your camera is in use elsewhere
camera.failed: Audio only — your camera couldn’t be started

cancelled.title: Call cancelled
cancelled.body: {name} hung up before the call connected.

busy.title: {name} is busy
busy.body: They’re in another call right now.

noAnswer.title: No answer
noAnswer.body: {name} didn’t pick up. They need Manteion open in a browser to get the call.

connectionFailed.title: Couldn’t connect
connectionFailed.body: Manteion connects calls directly between the two of you, without going through a server. Your networks didn’t allow that this time — it happens most often when both of you are on mobile data. Try again on Wi-Fi, or send a message instead.

connectionLost.title: Connection lost
connectionLost.body: The direct connection to {name} dropped and didn’t come back. Check your network and call again.

setupFailed.title: Couldn’t set up the call
setupFailed.body: Something went wrong while the two browsers were agreeing on how to talk. Try again; if it keeps happening, one of you may need a newer browser.

mediaDenied.title: Camera and microphone blocked
mediaDenied.body: Allow Manteion to use your camera and microphone in the browser’s settings for this site, then try again.

noDevices.title: No microphone found
noDevices.body: A call needs at least a microphone. Plug one in, or use another device.

mediaBusy.title: Camera or microphone in use
mediaBusy.body: Another app or tab is using it. Close that and try again.

mediaFailed.title: Couldn’t start the camera
mediaFailed.body: Something went wrong with your camera or microphone. Try again.

peerMediaFailed.title: {name} couldn’t start their camera
peerMediaFailed.body: Their browser didn’t let the call through. Send a message instead.

unsupported.title: Calls aren’t available here
unsupported.body: This browser or app can’t make video calls. Open Manteion in an up-to-date browser.

offline.title: No live connection
offline.body: Manteion isn’t connected to the server right now, so the call can’t be set up. Check your network and try again.

signalFailed.title: Couldn’t reach the server
signalFailed.body: The call couldn’t be set up. Try again in a moment.
